name: How We Dress
overview: Scripture instructs believers to honor God in how they dress by maintaining distinctions in gender-specific clothing and avoiding practices associated with ungodliness, such as marking the body for the dead. True beauty is not found in outward appearance or attire but in a heart that fears the Lord. Christians are called to present their bodies as living sacrifices, holy and acceptable to God, which includes being transformed in mind and conduct rather than conforming to worldly standards.
